metric_note: Binary full-set containment (expert subseteq decision set) per instance, sample-00 responses of the archived run. This is stricter than the benchmark's fractional containment metric (real Direct@8 .835), so the two numbers coexist and must not be conflated.
claim_supported: On the same 150 photos the decision-moving component is the rule engine, not the ranker: 128 paired flips against containment vs 1 for. With v1 (pre-bench-v2) perception the rules eliminate true expert processes, which is the measured collapse (Hybrid HARD F1 .086) and the case for calibrated perception first. No retrieval arm exists in the repo; the old with/without-retrieval agreement chart was assertion-only and is replaced by this paired comparison.
